descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Cultural Heritage Portrait for EDINBURGH PIPER AW26 Highland elder drop. Subject: a Scottish elder 72, of Lowland-Celtic lineage, full white beard trimmed neatly, white hair combed back beneath bonnet, ruddy complexion from decades of wind and whisky; Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush across cheekbones and nose-bridge. Wardrobe: full traditional formal Highland dress — a hand-woven 16oz worsted-wool kilt in tartan-royal-stewart-red #7A1820 and tartan-forest-green #244432 sett, eight-yard hand-basted pleats, thick cream kilt-hose with Stewart-red flashes, brogued ghillie shoes, a leather sporran with silver Celtic-knot cantle, a cream linen wing-collar jabot shirt with bone buttons, a jacket-charcoal-tweed #2C2F34 Prince Charlie tweed jacket and five-button waistcoat with polished staghorn buttons, clan badge at lapel, a blue glengarry bonnet with silver cap badge, cradling a Great Highland Bagpipe with Royal Stewart bag cover. Setting: a castle-stone-grey #9A9488 Edinburgh Castle courtyard, weathered basalt flagstones, blurred gun-grey curtain wall, a single flag snapping in wind. Composition: Rule of Thirds face 44% x 40% y, hero vertical, Eye-Level 0°, body slightly 3/4, both hands on chanter and drone, gaze level and dignified. Camera: Canon R5 · 85mm f/2.0 · 1/250s · ISO 200. Lighting: Overcast Diffuse Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — diffused Edinburgh sky camera-right 50° elevation (key soft cool), 4×4ft silver bounce camera-left 1.5m (fill on shadow side), 1×3ft strip rim camera-back-right 30° grazing glengarry and jacket shoulder (rim highlighting tweed), 4×4ft black flag below left to anchor kilt shadow. Material physics: worsted-wool tartan twill weight and drape, tweed nep boucle, linen plain-weave crisp, sporran fur matte, sterling-silver Celtic-knot specular, bagpipe blackwood satin. Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 emulation grain 6 +0.1 EV. Palette: tartan-royal-stewart-red 22%, tartan-forest-green 18%, jacket-charcoal-tweed 22%, castle-stone-grey 20%, skin-celtic-ruddy 18%. References: Don McCullin highlands, Harris Tweed campaign, National Geographic Scotland. Exclude: harsh flash, plastic skin, AI hallucination artifacts, cropped extremities, muddy shadows.
